args.title: Handle empty lines to prevent 'Malformed row' error
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts

Update the 'insertMany' function to handle cases where files end with an empty line, preventing a 'Malformed row' error.

label: bug
file: src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'insertMany' function in this file is responsible for inserting rows into the transactions database. It does not handle cases where files end with an empty line, resulting in a 'Malformed row' error.
